reason: A skill-management hub that aggregates local and packaged agent skills into a global library, making them available through the harness slash menu and settings panel.

summaries.zh: 将分散在本地目录和.skill包中的智能体技能导入、链接或复制到全局技能库，并通过设置面板进行管理。
summaries.en: Aggregates local and packaged agent skills into a global library for importing, editing, exporting, and slash-menu management.

capabilities: Scans configured local directories for skills
Creates symlinks or copies of skill directories in the global skill library
Edits SKILL.md files and records local skill metadata
Imports .skill packages and exports skill trees
Provides a settings panel and RPC-based directory browsing and management
